senses.gloss:
नट् नट् (a corrupted form of the original
rt. नृत्), cl. 1. P. नटति, ननाट, नटिष्-
यति, &c., to dance, to dance or perform as an actor,
to act; to injure by any deceptive trick; cl. 10. P.
नाटयति, &c., to represent anything (acc.) drama-
tically or by pantomime; to act; to drop or fall; to
injure; to speak or shine.

नट, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. नम्, Uṇādi-s.
IV. 104), a dancer, mime, actor, &c.; (in modern
times) N. for a particular caste, the son of a degraded
Kṣatriya by a woman of the second caste; the tree
Calosanthes Indica [cf. कुटन्नट]; Jonesia Asoka
(= अशोक); a sort of reed, Arundo Tibialis, or latterly
called Arundo Karka (= किष्कु-पर्वन्); a subor-
dinate mode of music; N. of a man who with his
brother Bhaṭa built a Vihāra; (आ), f. a species of
shrub, Cæsalpina Banducella; (ई), f. an actress, a
dancer, a Nauch girl; a courtezan, harlot; a species
of fragrant plant (= नली); red arsenic; N. of a
Rāgiṇī.
—नट-गति, इस्, f. a kind of metre con-
sisting of four times fourteen syllables.
—नट-
चर्या, f. the performance of an actor.
—नट-ता,
f. the office or state of a player, condition of an
actor.
—नट-नारायण, अस्, m. a Rāga or mode
of music, (according to some) the sixth, (or according
to others) a subdivision of that called Dīpaka or of
Megha.
—नट-पत्त्रिका, f. Solanum Melongena.
—नट-पर्ण, अम्, n. the skin (?).
—नट-भ-
टिक-विहार, अस्, m. ‘the temple of Naṭa and
Bhaṭa,’ N. of a temple on the mountain Uru-muṇḍa.
—नट-भूषण, अम्, n. ‘actor's ornament or
pigment,’ orpiment.
—नट-मण्डन, अम्, n.
‘actor's ornament,’ yellow orpiment.
—नट-रङ्ग,
अस्, m. ‘actor's’ stage, a theatrical stage,’ a meta-
phorical N. for anything illusory.
—नट-वटु, उस्,
m. (वटु said to be fr. rt. वट्), the son of an actor,
a young actor.
—नट-वर, अस्, m. a chief dancer
or actor.
—नट-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. a chief or excel-
lent dancer or actor.
—नट-सञ्ज्ञक, अस्, m. yellow
orpiment; an actor, a dancer, &c.; [cf. नट-भू-
षण and नट-मण्डन.]
—नट-सूत्र, अम्, n.
rules or directions for actors.
—नटान्तिका (˚ट-अन्˚),
f. shame, modesty; (also read नटान्धिका.)
—नटी-
सुत, अस्, m. the son of a dancing girl.
—नटेश्वर
(˚ट-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘the lord of dancers,’ an epithet
of Śiva.

नाट नाट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. नट्),
dancing, acting, a dance; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga-
rāja; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, = कर्णाटक,
the Carnatic; (ई), f., scil. भाषा, the language
spoken by the Nāṭas.
—नाटाम्र (˚ट-अम्˚), अस्, m.
the water-melon, Cucurbita Citrullus.

नटक, अस्, m. an actor.
—नटक-मेलक, अम्,
n. ‘the company of actors,’ N. of a comedy.

नाटक, अस्, ई, अम्, dancing, acting; (अम्), n. a
play, drama; the first of the ten pieces of dramatic
compositions of the first order; (अस्), m. an actor,
dancer, mime; N. of a mountain in Kāmākhyā;
(इका), f. a kind of play, see below; (अकी), f. the
court of Indra.
—नाटक-प्रपञ्च, अस्, m. course
or arrangement of a drama.
—नाटक-रत्न-कोष,
अस्, m. ‘treasure of jewels of plays,’ N. of a work.
—नाटक-विधि, इस्, m. mimic art, dramatic action.
—नाटकावतार (˚क-अव्˚), अस्, m., N. of a work.

नटन, अम्, n. (derived fr. नर्तन), the act of
dancing or representing dramatically, pantomime,
&c.; a dance.
नटी, f. an actress, &c. See under नट above.
नट्या, f. a company of actors.

नाट्य, अम्, n. dancing, mimic or dramatic repre-
sentation, a play; action on the stage, the science or
art of dancing or acting, scenic art, the union of song,
pantomime dance and instrumental music; the cos-
tume of an actor; (अस्), m. an actor, mime.
—नाट्य-
दर्पण, अम्, n. ‘mirror of acting,’ N. of a work.
[]
—नाट्य-धर्मिका or नाट्य-धर्मी, f. the rules
of dramatic representation.
—नाट्य-प्रिय, अस्, m.
‘fond of dancing,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—नाट्य-
लोचन-कार, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the
Nāma-liṅgānuśāsana by Amara-siṃha.
—नाट्य-शाला,
f. a room or building for dramatic exhibitions, a
theatre, a dancing-room, (according to some it should
be built near the gate of a palace.)
—नाट्य-शास्त्र,
अम्, n. any book on dancing or dramatic repre-
sentation.
—नाट्याचार्य (˚य-आच्˚), अस्, m. a danc-
ing-master.
—नाट्योक्ति (˚य-उक्˚), इस्, f. dramatic
phraseology.

नट्टपट्टग्राम नट्ट-पट्ट-ग्राम, अस्, m., N.
of a village.
नाटकेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

नाटार, अस्, m. (fr. नटी), the son of an actress;
[cf. नाटेर, नाटेय.]

नाटिका, f. a short or light comedy, the first of the
Upa-rūpakas or dramas of the second order.
नाटितक, अम्, n. a mimic representation, a gesture.

नाटेय, अस्, m. the son of an actress or dancing-
girl.
